en: To be honest, I don't know much about it either.
Are you fond of museums?
I see. I hope you have a good trip.
It'll be night soon, so do take care.
Thank you for the other day.
Excuse me? Is something the matter?
I see. I'm sorry.
It seems I disturbed you by calling out.
True, you can't see it all in one day.
I hope you enjoy your trip, Anna.
Excuse me? Is something wrong?
By the way, we've met before, haven't we?
Do you remember?
Take your time and enjoy it.
I'm drawn to old and time-honored things.

en: I am Vanessa.
My husband and I run an inn
together.
My husband minds the place by day,
and that is why I sit here having tea,
you see. Ho ho...
Say, if you like, why not come and stay
at our inn?
For a gentleman as charming as you, I'd
offer all sorts of special services.
Ah, perhaps I shall call on it one day.
Where is this inn?
Just north of this café.
Our inn does rather good business.
I'm sure you would be satisfied.
I'm Vanessa, the owner of the inn.
Seeing me drink tea here every day, you
might think I'm neglecting my business,
but that isn't so at all.
Sitting here like this is part of
my work too... Heh heh heh...
Hello. I'm Vanessa, from the inn.
Here in London, there are so many
poor girls looking for work, aren't there?
I help girls like that find
a line of work.
Surviving alone in this city is hard
for a woman, after all...
Ho ho ho... Good day to you,
note: Name follows on the next line with #98 ".".

en: The world is full of people with no food
and nowhere to sleep, poor things.
To poor girls like that, I
offer a way to earn a living.
It's simple.
All they have to do is take a customer.
Then they get a meal and a bed for the night
at my inn. That's how it works.
Of course, the room and my finder's fee
I take as my share, mind you.
People, too, live by preying
on one another...
Don't you think so, too?
Welcome to the inn...
Please, make yourself at home.
How was it?
Do come again, won't you?
I'll be waiting for you again.
Do stay and relax a while.
We look forward to your next visit.
Who is it?
Haven't you got the wrong room?
Have you come to see me, perhaps?
You told me something once.
People, too, prey on each other to live,
you said...
Y-yes. I did say that, it's true.
Then, if people prey on one another,
for those people to become a vampire's prey
is only natural. Isn't that so?
Wh-what on earth are you saying?
I have no idea what you mean...
Ah! What are you doing?!
note: No used_in; Vanessa's cry when attacked (between msgs 390257 and 390293).
